To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ammonium ion effect is specific to the suaC gene.

ammonium sensitivity is a ribosome-specific phenotype associated with suppressors in the ribosomal suaC gene of A. nidulans, and that this sensitivity is partially reversed by antisuppressors in the suaC109 suppressor allele.

ammonium ion sensitivity is: (a) a ribosomal phenotype; (b) a feature of both weak and strong suppressor suaC alleles; (c) associated with the suppressor phenotype of suaC; (d) a feature of suaC but not suaB, suaD or suaA; and (e) reversed by asu− mutations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the suppressor and ammonium ion effects.
the relationship between the suppressor phenotype and the ammonium ion-sensitivity of ribosomes.
the effects of ammonia on the ribosome and the role of the ribosome in ammonium ion toxicity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ammonium ion sensitivity is another aspect of the ribosomal phenotype associated specifically with mutations in the suaD gene.
ammonium ion sensitivity is associated with the suaC ribosomal suppressor mutation.
the suaC gene product is a ribosomal component which is sensitive to the presence, in vivo and in vitro, of ammonium, lithium and rubidiu ions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the suaC gene is a locus which affects ribosomes in a manner that is sensitive to ammonium ion.
the ammonium ion effect is a ribosomal phenomenon associated with the suaC gene.
ammonium ion sensitivity is another ribosomal phenotype associated exclusively with the suaC gene.
The main takeaway from our work is that

ammonium ion sensitivity is an important ribosomal phenotype associated specifically with the suaC gene, and that the suaC ribosomal suppressor phenotype may be a consequence of the ammonium ion-sensitivity.
ammonium ion sensitivity is an intrinsic ribosomal phenotype associated only with the suaC gene and is a feature of strong and weak alleles of this gene.
the ribosomal protein S6 is the most likely candidate to account for the ammonium ion phenotype.
